svg.title: YOLO-Toys Request Lifecycle
svg.desc: Six-stage request lifecycle: Ingress, Validation, Cache Check, Execution, Normalization, and Emission, with cache-hit and cache-miss branch paths annotated.
svg.text: Six stages from ingress to emission
model weights → GPU transfer → warm-up · +2–10 s
Pydantic rejects bad input before any model work begins
Cache hit is the fast path
Warm models serve in 4–18 ms; cold load is an exception, not the norm
Normalization isolates callers from per-adapter output variation
Cache hits, lazy loads, and concurrency limits shape real user-visible latency — the lifecycle is both a functional and operational path.
